author: Krozz_08
body:
Your build looks pretty good, not gonna lie.

But, you need ljosalfar sceptre and a least one or two immortal thing, robe or tunic for hp. The witch hat or yeti coat need immortal jewel for more hp = ward, the scroll is good, another variant for towers is mammon shield. Balor crown is another good variant.

Ljosalfar sceptre in ornate 95% gives you 1k hp and 900 magic, in 100% gives you +1k hp and +900 magic (you need it in ornanguish quality (orna + anguish) dispair 4 if it's possible.

Accessories, you need immortal ring in ornate, in 100% quality it gives you 1k hp. And as I said before, that hp becomes ward in a % 

And for towers, Ara is the most balanced, it gives you almost 2k hp, so you're gonna have almost 15-20k hp, and 20k or more ward.

Antlia is squishy, it gives you mag but is not worth for tower. 

Another thing, the bests followers for towers is breathing armor t8, stoneward, steward golem, fey yeti.

author: NyteLoki
body:
Ara is worth picking up for raids and pvp.  

You don't actually apply the sigils one at a time. You use the sigil storm flask. It applies them for a flask (granting another turn if the flask is full).  You use Omniblast to charge flasks faster. 

The skills are worth it for heretic Ara as well which adds to the spell list which makes towers easier.

(Edited for grammar)
